name: Z UpTime – Uptime Monitoring Node
author: zubbin

sections.description:
Z UpTime – Uptime Monitoring Node connects your WordPress site to the Zubbin monitoring platform.

After connecting, the plugin can:
* send regular heartbeat updates
* send WordPress inventory data such as runtime, theme, and plugins
* support uptime monitoring from the Zubbin platform
* support site health analysis in the Zubbin dashboard

The plugin is designed for production use on live WordPress sites and is suitable for site owners, developers, and agencies managing multiple installations.

The plugin does not affect frontend performance and runs in the background via standard WordPress hooks and scheduled tasks.

Features

  • Connect this WordPress site to the Zubbin platform
  • Automatic heartbeat monitoring
  • Site inventory sync
  • Core WordPress health checks
  • Lightweight and performance-safe
  • No frontend impact
  • Compatible with major WordPress hosts

External Services

This plugin connects to the Zubbin monitoring service operated by the plugin authors.

Service endpoints used by the plugin may include:
* https://app.zubbin.com/api/wp/connect
* https://app.zubbin.com/api/wp/heartbeat
* https://app.zubbin.com/api/wp/sync
* https://app.zubbin.com/api/wp/disconnect

When connected, the plugin may send:
* site URL and site name
* WordPress version
* PHP version
* plugin version
* active theme information
* installed plugin inventory
* user, plugin, and sync counts
* heartbeat and health check results
* optional support/contact fields configured by the site owner

This data is used to provide uptime monitoring, inventory sync, and site health analysis in the Zubbin platform.

Privacy Policy: https://zubbin.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://zubbin.com/terms
Support: https://zubbin.com/support
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Zubbin Uptime Node from the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Connect the site to the Zubbin platform.
  4. Confirm the site shows as connected.
  5. Use the dashboard, sync, help, privacy, and contact tabs as needed.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zubbin account?

The plugin connects to the Zubbin platform. Depending on your deployment, access to the Zubbin service may be required.

What data does the plugin send?

The plugin can send heartbeat, runtime, theme, plugin inventory, and basic site profile data as described in the External Services section above.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

The plugin is designed to be lightweight and relies on standard WordPress scheduling and background requests.

Does the plugin send alerts directly from WordPress?

No. Alerts and analysis are handled by the Zubbin platform.

  • Added heartbeat endpoint integration.
  • Added site inventory sync integration.

  • Added improved support, privacy, and help messaging.
  • Added compatibility bridge for upgrading older node installs.

  • Auth and packaging repair release.

  • Improves upgrade screen to display billing state.

1.4.45

  • Branding update to Z UpTime
  • Improved node auto-registration reliability
  • UI and stability improvements

1.4.36

  • Prefix hardening across all classes, hooks, options, and constants
  • WP.org-compliant build adjustments

1.4.19

  • Activity log improvements and Plugin Check warning resolution

1.4.17

  • Added Node Activity Log tab

1.4.12

  • WordPress.org compliance fixes
  • Security hardening and safe redirects
